title: LEVEL 20 PRESTIGE ROSTER
why: Answer 32 and m8a: only a level 20 pillager can prestige; three prestige lives, a star, level and picks kept, and a new heir. Watch: taking a veteran benches the heir; a veteran death or quit loses its star for good and restores that heir.
now: The existing hall holds the prestige roster. Prestige sends worn gear to the stash, opens the heir choice and pays no bonus. Switch veterans on the hub floor, with the current heir kept safely. LOCAL: no linked review.
